parse.wikitext:
===Levels 35–99: Smithing steel cannonballs===
Smithing [[steel cannonball]]s offers even slower experience than dart tips, but requires even less attention, and usually makes a [[Money making guide/Smithing steel cannonballs|profit]]. 4 cannonballs are created per steel bar; a [[double ammo mould]] smelts two steel bars at once, doubling the experience rates. A full inventory takes 160 seconds to process using Make-X, or roughly half that with a double ammo mould. 

At 87 [[Sailing]] players can smith cannonballs by using the [[ancient furnace]] in the [[Grimstone Dungeon]], which halves the time it takes to create cannonballs from 8 ticks to 4 ticks. Combining this with a double ammo mould, players can smith cannonballs at four times the normal speed with up to 6000 cannonballs per hour if using teleport methods to bank.
